name: geom_null
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM neighbourhoods WHERE geom IS NULL

name: invalid_geom
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM neighbourhoods WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geom)

name: geom_types
sql: SELECT string_agg(k||'='||n, ',' ORDER BY k) FROM (SELECT GeometryType(geom) k, count(*) n FROM neighbourhoods GROUP BY 1) s

name: geom_equals_geometry_derivation
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM neighbourhoods WHERE ST_AsBinary(geom) = ST_AsBinary(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(geometry::text), 4326))

name: census_all_14_non_null
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM neighbourhoods WHERE num_nulls(avg_household_income, median_household_income, avg_individual_income, low_income_pct, tenure_owner_pct, tenure_renter_pct, period_of_construction, couples_pct, lone_parent_pct, married_pct, university_degree_pct, immigrant_pct, visible_minority_pct, english_knowledge_pct) = 0

name: top_mother_tongue_non_null
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM neighbourhoods WHERE top_mother_tongue IS NOT NULL

name: id_key_map_hash
sql: SELECT md5(string_agg(id || ':' || neighbourhood_id, '|' ORDER BY id)) FROM neighbourhoods

name: shifted_key_range_rows
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM neighbourhoods WHERE neighbourhood_id >= 100000
